title: How much does a turnkey house renovation cost in Kyiv and the region in 2026

description: Turnkey house renovation cost in Kyiv and the Kyiv region: price per m², what drives the estimate, building services, common mistakes and remote supervision.
lead: Renovating a house is different from renovating an apartment: more building services, the facade, the plot, the boiler room. Here is what a turnkey house renovation costs, how the price is formed and how to keep the estimate from drifting.

How much a turnkey house renovation costs
p

At CAS Development a turnkey house renovation starts from $550 per m². The exact amount is fixed in the estimate after a site inspection: it depends on the condition of the house, its building services and the level of finishes. Indicative figures by floor area (area × rate):
ul
120 m² house — from $66,000
150 m² house — from $82,500
200 m² house — from $110,000
p

If we build the house from scratch, construction starts from $600 per m², and construction with turnkey finishing from $1,100 per m². Interior design starts from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500), furnishing from $250 per m², landscaping from $50 per 100 m² of plot.
h2
What affects the price most
ul
condition of the house: bare shell or an old renovation to strip out
building services: heating, boiler room, underfloor heating, ventilation, water and drainage
floor area and number of bathrooms
level of finishes and materials
bespoke furniture and [turnkey procurement](/en/turnkey-procurement)
stairs, double-height spaces, large windows and non-standard ceilings

h2
Why a house is more complex than an apartment
p

In a house you are responsible for all the building services yourself: boiler, heating circuit, water treatment, drainage. Mistakes in services do not show immediately, but they are the most expensive to fix. So engineering decisions go into the design before works start: where the boiler stands, how pipes run, what capacity the house needs, where access hatches for maintenance go.
p

A house also has more spaces that are easy to underestimate: vestibule, boiler room, walk-in wardrobes, terrace, garage. Each needs its own decision on heating, lighting and finishes, and all of it must be in the estimate from the start.

h2
What to check before renovating a house
p
Before pricing the finishes, we need to understand what we are working with. During the inspection we look at:
ul
walls and floor slabs: cracks, damp, mould
the roof and drainage: leaks, where rainwater goes
windows and insulation: draughts, cold corners
heating: boiler type, condition of pipes and radiators
electrics: incoming capacity, condition of wiring and the panel
water and drainage: borehole or mains, septic tank
p

The inspection decides whether existing services can be kept or are better replaced entirely. Sometimes it is wiser to put part of the budget into the roof and insulation and keep finishes simpler — we make that decision together with you after the inspection.
h2
Stages of a turnkey house renovation
p
The sequence in a house is similar to an apartment, with the roof, facade and boiler room added. The overall order is:
ol
house inspection, interior design with engineering solutions, and estimate
demolition and fixing structural, damp and roof problems
building services: boiler room, heating, water, drainage, ventilation, electrics
rough works: partitions, plaster, screed, waterproofing
finishing: tiles, floors, ceilings, painting, stairs, doors
furniture, lighting, procurement and, if needed, landscaping
cleaning, testing all systems and handover with a signed certificate
p

The most important rule: do not move on to finishes until heating and water supply have been started up and tested. A trial run of the systems before walls and floors are closed lets you find leaks while they are still easy to fix.
h2
Common house renovation mistakes
ul
starting with finishes without checking the roof, damp and services
choosing a boiler and radiators without calculating them for the specific house
not planning ventilation — then condensation and odours appear
splitting design and renovation between contractors without a shared estimate
putting off decisions on furniture and lighting until the end
h2
How to stay within the estimate
ul
start with a design and a detailed estimate
agree changes in writing and before they are made
inspect concealed works before they are closed
work with one team responsible for both design and renovation
p

If we carry out the renovation to our design, we guarantee the final cost will stay within ±5% of the agreed estimate, and additional works are done only after your written approval. We send regular photo reports via Telegram or WhatsApp.

faq: How much does it cost to renovate a 200 m² house?
The benchmark is from $550 per m², so from $110,000 for 200 m². We quote the exact amount after an inspection and estimate.
Can I follow the renovation remotely?
Yes. We send regular photo reports via Telegram or WhatsApp, and one manager is available for all questions — convenient if you live abroad.
Which is cheaper: renovating an old house or building a new one?

It depends on the condition of the structure and services. Renovation starts from $550 per m², construction with turnkey finishing from $1,100 per m²; after the inspection we explain which makes more sense in your case.
Do you give a warranty on house renovation?
Yes, completed works carry a 12-month warranty from handover.
